# Test data

These skeleton exports and atlases are the official Spine example projects,
copied unmodified from
[EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes](https://github.com/EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes)
(branch 4.2, `examples/*/export/`). They are covered by the Spine Runtimes
License Agreement (see ../LICENSE) and are used here only for testing the
runtime port.

| Skeleton | Exercises |
|---|---|
| spineboy | IK, transform constraints, meshes, events |
| raptor | weighted meshes, IK chains |
| coin | clipping, shear timelines |
| celestial-circus | physics constraints (30), heavy deforms |
| mix-and-match | skins (34), linked meshes, skin bones/constraints |
